4. World Almanac/NPCs/Anselm Corrow.md.text: Corrow is not part of the Silent Ascendency and does not know what the 'special cargo' is or who is behind it.
Corrow has long known that some manifests pay above the standard toll, and has chosen not to ask why.
Corrow does not know his senior clerk, Ostwin Reyes, is the Ascendency's contact.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Baba Lysaga (COS)..text: Baba Lysaga traded Mab a future favor for a pack of yeth hounds and a glamour that lets her pass as a fey bargain-broker.
Baba Lysaga means to trap Strahd's killers the moment they enter fey territory.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Hesper Crane.md.text: Hesper Crane never met the real Velmont; she dealt only with Marrow wearing his face, through couriers and a password exchange.
Hesper Crane knows Vecna only as 'the Undying King.'
Hesper Crane's ledger named the network's next contact in Duskferry, known only as 'the Tallyman.'

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Izek Strazni (COS).text: Izek's fiendish arm was a gift from Vecna, granted from inside the Amber Temple.
Izek's arm is the Hand of Vecna, grafted onto the stump the dire wolf left.
Vecna speaks to Izek through the Hand, and Izek obeys out of debt, not compulsion.
The amber under Izek's skin is the same Eludrax soul-craft as the Amber Wardens' conduits and Marrow's graft.
Izek knows what the casked distillate leaving Greyfen Hollow is for.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lord Caldris Velmo.text: The Silent Ascendency captured Velmont and took over his magic-item smuggling operation.
Velmont built the smuggling ring himself, years before the Ascendency seized it.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Marrow.md.text: The dwarf's confession to leading the Bruokdon cell was a lie.
The dwarf was Marrow's frame, a cultist primed to take the fall.
Marrow took Lyssandra for her illusion mastery, earmarked for future ward-work.
Marrow knew Vecna only by title: the Whispered One, God of Secrets, the Undying King.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Naerissa.md.text: Naerissa does not know whether Faerah's sister survived; she knows only that the sister did not leave with them.
The larger Unbroken Circle congregation lives in the Greenfall wilds.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ostwin Reyes.md.text: Reyes falsifies or omits manifest entries for 'special cargo' shipments in exchange for payment.
Reyes knows the shipments' onward route toward Greyfen Hollow, but not what happens there.
